records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6:11 — Starting member loading from setupController without returning or handling the promise bypasses route error handling, so failed requests leave the member page empty or stale with an unhandled rejection.
records.rationale: The diff replaces the previous pattern in group-members.js.es6 (afterModel returning model.findMembers().then(...)) with setupController calling model.findMembers() without returning the promise. So failed member fetches no longer flow through the route's promise/error handling, and the unreturned rejection can leave the member list empty/stale. The mechanism is accurately described and verifiable from the diff, though the practical severity is modest.

Any external API consumer of GET /groups/:group_id/members relying on the array shape or unbounded list would break with no compat/versioned endpoint shown in the diff.
